name: US equity stress
summary: VIX rose to about 32 on 20 Nov, above the 30 Alert line, after the S&P 500 entered a correction on 19 Nov
state: The VIX was near 32 at 17:25 UTC on 20 Nov, up about 40% on the week and above the 30 Alert line for the first time since March (Yahoo Finance; Nacionale). The S&P 500 was about 10.2% below its 52-week high after it and the Dow entered a correction on 19 Nov in an AI-led sell-off (CNBC), and Asian shares fell on 20 Nov after a sixth straight Wall Street decline (Saxo). The drawdown is inside the 15% line, so the Alert rests on volatility.
for_you: US equity markets are in a high-volatility stress regime. Pensions, ISAs and funds with US shares are exposed to large daily swings while it lasts.
rubric_hit: VIX 32.0 > 30 Alert line; S&P 500 drawdown 10.2% in the 5–15% Watch band

sources.title: CNBC — S&P 500 and Dow enter correction, Nasdaq wipes out 2026 gain as AI sell-off deepens
Saxo — Asian stocks tumble after Wall Street's sixth straight decline

why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
